entities.name: HIV-1 Nef-like protein
observations: 203-aa query is 77.8–78.8% identical over 99.5–100% coverage to reviewed HIV-1 Nef references; function assignment is strong homology support.

Nef references describe immune evasion, including down-regulation of CD4 and MHC-I, and association with host membrane/Golgi compartments; these are reference annotations, not direct assays of the query.
Query-derived properties: 23.31 kDa predicted mass, pI 5.83, GRAVY −0.754; Pfam F-protein domain PF00469 spans residues 2–202.
